craChecks.requirement: Maintain a machine-readable SBOM of components (Annex I Part II).
Apply regular vulnerability scanning (Annex I Part II).
Ship without known exploitable vulnerabilities; no Critical at release (Annex I Part I).
Remediate vulnerabilities without undue delay; track High and above (Annex I Part II).
Declare the product as the SBOM top-level component (Annex I Part II).
Record when and by which tool the SBOM was generated (Annex I Part II).
Give every SBOM component a purl/CPE and a version (Annex I Part II).
Ship with no known-exploited (CISA KEV) vulnerabilities (Annex I Part I).
Document a mitigation for unfixable Critical/High findings (Annex I).
Apply available security updates for High+ findings (Annex I Part II).
craChecks.note: 2 High+ with an available fix still present.

craChecks.requirement: Scan against a recently-updated vulnerability database (Annex I Part II).
Publish a coordinated-vulnerability-disclosure policy / security contact (Annex I Part II 5-6; Article 13).
Provide an RFC 9116 security.txt security contact (Annex I Part II point 6).
